chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 251 – The Immortal Gathering: A Battle of 100,000 True Geniuses
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns of the Immortal Gathering—a dynasty-wide event where only the top ten out of over 100,000 Wanxiang geniuses can catch the eyes of Three Realms-level mighty figures.
og_title: The Immortal Gathering Revealed: Over 100,000 Wanxiang Monsters vs. One Sword Immortal
og_description: Ji Ning sits on a boat, drinks spirit-wine, and slowly learns that his victory over Snowfeather Daoist is just the prologue to a far bloodier stage.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 251 – The Scale of Xianxia Peak Competition
twitter_description: Over 80% of Celestial Immortals made their name at the Immortal Gathering. Ji Ning now knows the bell tolls for him too.

lore_anchors.definition: A dynasty-wide competition hosted by the Grand Xia, open to cultivators below Primal Daoist level. The top ten may be accepted as disciples by beings who transcend Celestial Immortals.
The cultivation realm above Celestial Immortal, achieved by fully comprehending a complete Grand Dao and surviving further tribulations.
A complete Grand Dao that Yu Wei has mastered, granting her dominion over ice. In the novel's cosmology, mastering a Grand Dao is the prerequisite for becoming a True Immortal.
A cultivator who retains memories from a past life as an Immortal. Their talent, power ceiling, and awakening speed vary greatly depending on the strength of their previous incarnation.

The fourth major Ki Refining realm; "Wanxiang" means "myriad manifestations." Cultivators at this level develop stars, moons, and suns within their Violet Palace, vastly accelerating their energy absorption.
